plans.idea: Use nearly the full strip width with the full height so the quote runs on one line at the biggest size the 90px height allows, read left to right: quote mark, then the line, then the attribution, all flush left; the empty minor slot sits as a small sliver at the far right.

A centred testimonial block: one full-height text column in the middle of the banner with equal side space, so the quote sits as a calm, balanced statement like a pull-quote; the tiny minor slot hides at the left edge.

Keep the original's generous left indent by setting a deliberate empty gutter on the left (the minor slot) and running the text flush left from about one sixth of the width, so the quote keeps the source's editorial, offset feel while staying on one line.
